title: Converge release evidence corrective delivery
outOfScope: Publishing a release, creating tags or provider assets, and merging the already-failed stacked corrective PRs.

sources.reason: Hosted failure proves stale Capability Truth escaped the old finish path.
Canonical finish flow requiring the deterministic pre-Outcome gate.
Failed stacked documentation-alignment PR retained as audit evidence, not a merge target.

riskAssessment.reason: This replaces, rather than stacks on, failed corrective delivery so one PR can remain one Work Item.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized corrective Work Items, their PR lifecycle, and release preparation.

preReviewWarnings: Do not merge PR #514 or the capability-gate prototype directly; this Work Item is the single-Work-Item replacement.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A single replacement PR based on #513 contains the Capability Truth finish gate and no stacked corrective archive records.
ai-finish runs the deterministic Capability Truth check before Outcome creation even when quality is explicitly skipped.
The stale-matrix regression and focused Capability Truth, Japanese assessment, and documentation-alignment checks pass.
Hosted CI remains mandatory before release work resumes.
guidelines: Use only the canonical deterministic Capability Truth validator; do not add a duplicate rule engine.
Preserve fail-closed behavior and do not regenerate evidence silently during finish.
Regenerate dependent evidence in matrix, Japanese assessment, documentation-alignment order.

intent.problem: The #514 hosted run exposed stale Capability Truth, and stacking corrective Work Items on that PR would violate the one-PR-one-new-Work-Item guard when merged.
constraints: Deliver from #513's head without inheriting #514/#515 archive records.
Do not weaken broad hosted verification; local broad quality remains skipped only under the user's temporary efficiency allowance.
Retain failed PRs as audit evidence until final documented cleanup.
intent.rationale: A fresh replacement Work Item makes the repair independently reviewable and structurally eligible for the repository PR gate.

verification.reason: Temporary user efficiency authorization permits focused local verification; hosted PR CI remains mandatory.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized the full corrective, PR, merge, closure, cleanup, and release plan.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
rawUserRequest: 继续执行所有已授权的纠正工单；需要时自行查看 Actions；在全部目标计划完成前不要停止。

declaredIntent.summary: Replace stacked failed release corrective delivery with one structurally valid evidence-freshness Work Item.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Capability Truth is stale while broad quality is skipped.

scenarioCoverage.expected: PR aggregate sees exactly one new Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run check-ai-pr with #513 head as base.
